set.t: Sod-shanty site (stood 32 yrs) likely near the SW corner of the section; the later house (no cellar) in the SE¼ SW¼. NW¼ was probably the tree claim. Homestead SW¼ sec 14 confirmed by GLO patent (1885); NW¼ was his 1895 tree claim. Private farmland: permission needed.

src: BLM GLO patents: STA-MN0440__.247 (SW¼ sec 14, 20 May 1885) and TC-0211-260 (NW¼, Timber Culture, 12 Mar 1895)
Fargo Forum, 7 Oct 1916, p. 10 (funeral 6 Oct 1916, Concordia church)
